meta_description:
6,118 likes, 57 comments - casarthakahuja on October 6, 2026: "People are now adding cloves to their coffee…

Clove Coffee is an antioxidant drink being pitched among wellness circles… where you take a piece of clove, crush it and add it to a cup of black coffee every morning…

It’s said that the heat takes away the odd flavour of the clove, and the compound called eugenol present in clove helps with digestion and inflammation management, while being helpful in pre-diabetes…

There aren’t many studies to support the claims in medical sciences

But eugenol is slowly taking off in wellness circles quite like there is curcumin from turmeric

So clove could follow a similar path... where after this you might see eugenol extracts in ready to drink beverages... and two things will help the wave...

1/ Brands that fund clinical studies to validate the claims for the product

2/ As 70% of the cloves are grown in Indonesia, a great bunch is imported into India... and building a thorough supply chain in this may help.

Would you add clove in your coffee?

#casarthakahuja".
